minutes_text:
OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, March 212020

1.  The meeting was called to order by Chairperson Craig Walters at 8:31 a.m.

  Advisory Board Members present: Craig Walters, Chris Gendreau, Micky Rehm, Jason
  Miller and Matt Forgey. Advisory Board Members absent: Marianne Stark. City
  Representatives present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer and
  Administrative Clerk Natalie Hiatt.

2.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES - January 6,2020 and February 3,2020

  It was moved by Mr. Walters and seconded by Mr. Gendreau to approve the minutes of
  January 6,2020 and February 3,2020 the meeting as submitted. Motion carried by a 4-0
  vote (Mr. Forgery arrived after vote).

3.  CALENDAR

  Cool Cruise - Mr. Scherer the stated the Cool Cruise contract is open for review for the
  remaining year of the contract. It will be presented to the promoter to move Cruisin' La
  Verne to Saturday, November 21't (weekend before Thanksgiving) to avoid a conflict
  with Shop Small Saturday.

  SGV Open Street Event - Mr. Gendreau stated the next meeting is scheduled for
  Wednesday, March 1lth.

4.  NEW BUSINESS

  A. Budget Overview - Mr. Scherer stated that the revenue difference was due to the
  Beer Walk not being as successful. The street lights were kept in the budget for next
  year with a focus on Third Street. Verizon expected to begin construction at
  Mainiero Square beginning of summer. The Holiday Stroll budget increased due to
  tree decorating and lighting.

  It was by moved by Mr. Miller and seconded by Ms. Rehm to approve the budget and
  recommend approval by the City Council. Motion carried by a 5-0 vote.

  B. Cool Cruise Request- Mr. Scherer stated that competing food vendors would not be
  allowed at the event.
 5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  A. Wine Walk Update - Mr. Walters stated the website went live on March 1't. Tickets
  are also available for purchase at Micky's and City Hall. The Kentucky Derby theme
  is "We're off to the Races". Post card estimated delivery is April 1tt.

  Ms. Rehm suggested the hat theme be promoted on social media.

6.  COMMITTEE REPORTSruPDATES

  City Report - Eric Scherer

  Mr. Scherer stated that Kohl's is downsizing to a smaller space and a grocery store would
  occupy the empty space. The name of the glocery store has not been released yet.

  An application was received by Chuze Fitness for the space previously occupied by Osh.
  Proposed facility will include pool, spa, movie theater, kids center and juice bar. The
  appiication will be presented to flanning Commission on March 1lft.

  The Gold Line is estimated to complete extension in2025 with a possibility for delay if
  the line extends further.

  University of La Verne Report - Jason Miller

  Mr. Miller stated that there are no major construction projects to report but there is an
  upcoming discussion for the development of the packing house.

  Marketing - Micky Rehm

  Ms. Rehm requested ads for the Wine Walk.

  Chamber of Commerce Report - Leah Skinner

  Ms. Skinner announced the following promotions: The Shop La Verne Mastercard gift
  card to be used at participating businesses. The "Shop La Verne, Save the World" event
  to be held on July I lth and partnered with a global non-profit.

  Social Media Update - Micky Rehm

  None

  None,
